text:
Situation: Dacarbazine is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 11 vials of 10 mg/mL 10 mL (2.9 days) and 33 vials of 200 mg (9.1 days). Corvale General holds 45 vials of 10 mg/mL 10 mL (15.8 days) and 38 vials of 200 mg (13.3 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 9 vials of 10 mg/mL 10 mL (9.7 days). All 10 mg/mL 10 mL vials are labeled by Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (NDC 63323012710).

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows a shortage first posted on 2021-10-20, since resolved. FDA inspection 1123748 at Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC ended 2020-05-18, classified OAI with letter dated 2024-05-22. Inspection 1174894 at the same plant ended 2022-06-30, classified OAI with letter dated 2024-04-30. Inspection 1216183 ended 2023-08-24, classified VAI with letter dated 2023-10-31.

Our position: No active FDA shortage. Corvale East 10 mg/mL supply is critically low at 2.9 days. Other sites have adequate stock. Alternate manufacturers and concentrations are available.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 5 vials of 10 mg/mL 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Purchase dacarbazine from Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. — approved by buyer.
3. Use dacarbazine 200 mg/1 from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. with pharmacist verification — approved by pharmacist.
4. Use dacarbazine 10 mg/mL from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC with pharmacist verification — approved by pharmacist.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
